snippet.title: Video Dev Blog: The Hammer Blow | Ashes of the Singularity II
snippet.description:
Today we show some footage from the closing moments of an internal test game played over at Oxide Studios. A PHC player has outmaneuvered the Substrate, bringing the full might of his army in as a hammer blow to smash their HQ, and win the match.

Wishlist Ashes of the Singularity 2 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499790/Ashes_of_the_Singularity_II/
